newsitem.title: USA: IMM currency futures slip more late, end lower.
newsitem.headline: IMM currency futures slip more late, end lower.

text.p: April 14 - IMM currency futures dipped again late, ended lower. June marks, Canadian dollar each set new contract low, at $0.5804 and $0.7174, respectively, in last hour as US stocks rose. But volume very light before Tuesday's US March CPI, seen up 0.2 pct, core up 0.3 pct. Treasury secretary Rubin's comments had no effect. He said US dollar policy unchanged.
